moments.title: Premier League Weekend
moments.blurb: Matchweek 4 of the Premier League continues with a packed Saturday of fixtures and a huge Manchester derby on Sunday.

angles.name: Saturday Kick-off
angles.copy: Premier League is back! Massive Saturday of football today with Chelsea, Liverpool, Tottenham and Arsenal all in action. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Derby Day Preview
angles.copy: Get ready for a huge Sunday! The Manchester derby kicks off tomorrow as United host City. Who's taking the bragging rights?

moments.title: Reminisce Festival
moments.blurb: The UK's biggest throwback dance festival, Reminisce, takes over Sherdley Park in St Helens today with a huge lineup of 90s and 00s dance acts.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Hands in the air if you're at Reminisce Festival today! Reliving the best of 90s and 00s dance anthems in St Helens. What's your favourite throwback tune?

angles.name: Lineup Shoutout
angles.copy: Baby D, Basshunter, Vengaboys, East 17! The legends are out in force at Reminisce Festival today. Who are you buzzing to see?

moments.title: Waterworks Festival
moments.blurb: London's Waterworks Festival brings a diverse lineup of electronic music artists to East London for a two-day event this weekend.

angles.name: London Dance
angles.copy: Waterworks Festival is ON in London! Two days of the best electronic music kicking off today. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Weekend Beats
angles.copy: Soundtracking your weekend: Waterworks Festival in London is bringing the beats. Tune in for some electronic vibes!

moments.title: Jennifer Hudson's 45th Birthday
moments.blurb: Today, September 12th, marks the 45th birthday of Oscar and Grammy-winning singer and actress Jennifer Hudson.

angles.name: Happy Birthday JHud
angles.copy: Celebrating the incredible Jennifer Hudson, who turns 45 today! What's your favourite song or movie moment from the powerhouse vocalist?

angles.name: Dreamgirl to Icon
angles.copy: From American Idol to Oscar winner, Jennifer Hudson has done it all. Happy 45th Birthday to a true talent!

moments.title: RM (BTS) 32nd Birthday
moments.blurb: Kim Namjoon, better known as RM, the leader of global K-pop sensation BTS, celebrates his 32nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday RM
angles.copy: Happy 32nd Birthday to RM, the incredible leader of BTS! Drop your favourite BTS track to celebrate!

angles.name: Global Leader
angles.copy: From Seoul to stadiums worldwide, RM has led BTS to global superstardom. Wishing him a fantastic 32nd birthday!

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart
moments.blurb: Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' holds strong at Number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for the week of September 10-16, with new entries from Miley Cyrus.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' is holding strong this week. What's your favourite from the current chart?

angles.name: New Music Alert
angles.copy: New entry on the Official Singles Chart from Miley Cyrus with 'Bass Persuades'! Hear it now on Nation Hits!

moments.title: Heritage Open Days
moments.blurb: Heritage Open Days continue across England until September 20th, offering free access to thousands of historical sites and unique local stories.

angles.name: Explore History
angles.copy: Discover hidden gems and local history for free! Heritage Open Days are still running across England until September 20th. Where will you explore?

angles.name: Free Days Out
angles.copy: Looking for a free day out this weekend? Heritage Open Days offer unique insights into England's past. Find an event near you!

moments.title: London Design Festival
moments.blurb: The London Design Festival is underway until September 20th, showcasing innovative design, architecture, and art installations across the capital.

angles.name: Capital of Design
angles.copy: London is buzzing with creativity! The London Design Festival is on now, transforming the city with stunning installations and exhibitions. What's caught your eye?

angles.name: Art & Innovation
angles.copy: From striking art to cutting-edge architecture, the London Design Festival is a must-see. Explore the capital's creative side this week!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Launch
moments.blurb: The much-anticipated launch show for Strictly Come Dancing series 24 airs next Saturday, September 19th, on BBC One, revealing this year's celebrity pairings.

angles.name: Strictly's Back
angles.copy: Get ready to cha-cha-cha! Strictly Come Dancing returns next Saturday, September 19th, for its star-studded launch show. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: New faces in the ballroom! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe host the new series of Strictly, starting next weekend!

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival
moments.blurb: The acclaimed Abergavenny Food Festival returns next weekend, September 19-20, celebrating Welsh produce with tastings, demos, and live music.

angles.name: Welsh Foodie Fun
angles.copy: Food lovers, get ready! The Abergavenny Food Festival is next weekend, bringing the best of Welsh produce and culinary delights. Who's joining the feast?

angles.name: Taste of Wales
angles.copy: From chef demos to artisan markets, Abergavenny Food Festival is the place to be for a taste of Wales next weekend!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back for its 17th series on Tuesday, September 22nd, introducing Nigella Lawson as the new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off's Back!
angles.copy: On your marks, get set, BAKE! The Great British Bake Off returns Tuesday 22nd September with a brand new judge, Nigella Lawson! Who's excited?

angles.name: Nigella in the Tent
angles.copy: The tent is open for business and Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood as a judge! Don't miss the new series of Bake Off, starting Sept 22nd.

moments.title: Chuck Panozzo (Styx) 78th Birthday
moments.blurb: Chuck Panozzo, the bassist and co-founder of classic rock band Styx, will celebrate his 78th birthday on September 20th.

angles.name: Styx Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to Chuck Panozzo of Styx on September 20th! What's your go-to Styx anthem?

moments.title: Nuno Bettencourt (Extreme) 60th Birthday
moments.blurb: Extreme guitarist Nuno Bettencourt will turn 60 on September 20th, known for his iconic shredding and songwriting.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 60th Birthday to the incredible Nuno Bettencourt of Extreme on September 20th! What's your favourite guitar solo?

moments.title: Magic at the Musicals
moments.blurb: Magic Radio celebrates its 10th anniversary of 'Magic at the Musicals' at the Royal Albert Hall on Sunday, September 20th, featuring stars from West End productions.

angles.name: West End Wonders
angles.copy: Get ready for a magical night! Magic at the Musicals celebrates 10 years at the Royal Albert Hall next Sunday, September 20th. Who's your favourite musical theatre star?
